boundary: Fixed local procedures only. No arbitrary commands, credentials, remote execution, cloud changes, external network contact, or destructive action.

procedures.name: Office child-process telemetry marker
procedures.action: Write a run-owned parent/child process marker; no document or macro is opened.

procedures.name: Script-host telemetry marker
procedures.action: Write a run-owned script-host validation marker; no script host is launched.

procedures.name: WMI persistence telemetry marker
procedures.action: Write a run-owned WMI-subscription validation marker; no WMI subscription is created.
procedures.expected_detection: WMI subscription creation detection test evidence.

procedures.name: Credential-protection validation
procedures.action: Record a local protection-validation marker; no process memory is accessed or dumped.
procedures.expected_detection: Credential protection or suspicious process-access detection test evidence.

procedures.name: Dummy sensitive-data handling
procedures.action: Create and read a run-owned dummy test record; no real data is accessed.
procedures.expected_detection: DLP or data-staging detection test evidence.

procedures.name: Local inventory validation
procedures.action: Record a fixed local platform summary; no network or directory enumeration occurs.

procedures.name: Loopback transfer validation
procedures.action: Write a fixed dummy transfer marker to the run only; no external connection is made.
procedures.expected_detection: Internal transfer or egress-control test evidence.

procedures.name: Run-owned canary rename
procedures.action: Rename one run-owned dummy canary file; no production or user file is touched.
procedures.expected_detection: Canary or suspicious file-rename detection test evidence.
